title: What file converter should i us to convert MP4 movies into ogg files?

posts.author: socon
posts.body: I have a movie that I'd like to import into rpg maker vx ace but it's a MP4 so what file converter do you use to to convert to ogg? Please and thank you.

posts.author: EntangledPear
posts.body: VLC media player has the convert function and you can choose ogg there for video, so it should work.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Doesn't really matter. Every online converter out there is capable of doing that in seconds.
